we establish near-optimal sample complexity bounds for \emph{offline RL} under the standard \emph{linear} function approximation setting, and the results hold for both episodic and infinite-horizon MDPs.

\textbf{we provide a novel algorithm for offline RL that is near-optimal in terms of sample complexity and computational complexity}. Our algorithm is based on a novel variance reduction technique that we refer to as \emph{sparse double variance reduction}.
